assumptions.text: Public state could support explanation; noticing and comprehension under pressure remain unproved.
An expectation reversal can be discovered, then become predictably usable.
Metaphors may help or hinder causal understanding.

findings.title: Dangerous custody survives title removal; readable fallback needs causal distinctions
findings.documented_fact: Preserving a dangerous courier allows delivery-dependent attack amendment. The ordinary scheduler does not wait, and failed or unresolved delivery falls back without refund. Ordinary collateral is retained.
findings.interpretation: The reversal remains without its name, but death, deadline, admission expiry and owner loss must not collapse into an unexplained failure. Public fields are not measured comprehension.

findings.title: Intended gesture, actual endpoint and admitted coverage are separate meanings
findings.documented_fact: Actual post-collision zones populate memory. Only a new eligible displacement evaluates matching, coverage capacity prevents queued replacements, and the third gestured revision requires a refill after two initial charges.
findings.interpretation: A public taught commitment may support predictable surprise, but describing shape learning or automatic retrigger would misstate the current rule. No actual confusion was observed.

findings.title: Scoped contradiction is temporal/spatial, with cost retained
findings.documented_fact: C02 makes cast completion depend on leaving an origin-sensitive region. C04 preserves hit damage and later settles the recorded shove on attack or timeout. Reserves connect opposing traffic to acceleration and waiting to ordered-record pruning.
findings.interpretation: These relations survive deleting metaphors; they do not require formal inconsistency. Feedback lists do not establish players distinguish origin/current membership or damage/displacement.

findings.title: Main benefit-to-liability relation is defined; shadow reserve downside is not
findings.documented_fact: Main C05 couples reach and fee, while base actions already deplete the budget and exhaustion requires seal interaction. Final actual spend is capped. B12 defers shadow protection because its operative cost is inadequate.
findings.interpretation: The main economic metaphor can be removed while retaining its reversal; the shadow reserve cannot yet explain a meaningful assistance cost.
findings.readiness: flag for V1; unresolved operative cost blocks promoting V2 trade-off
findings.severity: high for reserve claim; material for representative explanation

findings.title: Versioned commitment explains indirection; sarcasm and musical-quality claims are absent
findings.documented_fact: C06 distinguishes current shared clause from last-read locked route. Its reserve mutates a transferable one-use bearer predicate. Route reserve matching is open; phrase reserve shares a rest slot without a musical-quality rule. Local principles distinguish kinds of irony, surprise and inconsistency.
findings.interpretation: Operations primarily explore expectation reversal and indirection. They do not test sarcastic delivery or measured comedic response. Compatibility alone may be conventional, but no originality judgment is supplied by this role.

questions_for_synthesis: Which outcomes and costs can be predicted before irreversible commitment?
Can both control modes distinguish the state pairs central to intended meaning?
Does the title-free relation produce intelligible alternatives, beyond the investigator reading?
Which reserve interpretations must remain deferred until matching, cycle or operative downside is defined?
Can conventional substitutes reproduce the explanation as well as action choices?
Which claim is being assessed: generator construction, inspected-set distinction, surprise, depth, or verbal humor?
